stories.title: A24's teaser for Nathan Fielder's Elizabeth Holmes documentary
stories.summary: A24 posted the first teaser for You Can See Everything, a documentary by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim that follows Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes in the 34 days before she reported to prison. People fixated on the close-ups of the two sizing each other up, with one quote calling it "the look of a fake lunatic realizing he's met a real one".
